## Job Market Paper

**The Impact of Refugee Arrivals on Food Security, Income, and Crop Prices in Rural Uganda**  
*Under Review, Economic Development and Cultural Change*

::: {.abstract-block}
[Abstract]{.abstract-label} This paper examines how large-scale refugee arrivals affect the welfare of host communities in rural Uganda. Using a household panel and plausibly exogenous variation in refugee inflows, I estimate effects on food security, household income, and local agricultural prices.
